label: r0c
issues: No cab/roll-bar structure — the tractor's signature red canopy and pillars are missing entirely
Wheels are square stud-faced plates rather than round tires; rear wheels not noticeably larger than front
Yellow is scattered as random stud patches instead of a clean lower-body stripe
Body is too blocky and short; dark grey dominates where red should, weakening the red/black/yellow blocking
Exhaust stack is oversized and offset from the hood centre
distilled: A small stocky LEGO tractor with big rounded rear wheels, smaller front wheels, a boxy engine hood, and a simple cab with a curved-slope roof, standing still on a flat base.
